metadata.title: Positive Scalar Curvature on Foliations: Long Neck Problem
metadata.abstract: We prove estimates for Gromov's Long Neck Foliated Conjecture in the spin cases, which involves leafwise scalar curvature. The same methods yield a quantitative version of a theorem of Su--Wang--Zhang and a Llarull-type theorem for closed foliated manifolds. A refinement, which involves mean curvature and partially generalizes a theorem of Cecchini--Zeidler, is also obtained.

analysis.progressType: foliation 正标量曲率的 Long-Neck 障碍
analysis.workSummary: 利用 spin 方法证明 leafwise Long-Neck 型估计，量化既有正标量曲率障碍，给 foliated Llarull 与含 boundary mean curvature 的结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 把定量刚性与边界几何引入 leafwise 标量曲率。
analysis.limitations: spin 与 boundary 条件按各定理保留；边界版本是既有问题的部分结果。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者完成初稿后用 AI 校对，并将 Theorem 4.5 扩展为弱化 leafwise distance 条件的 Theorem 1.7；Theorem 4.6 由 AI 建议，作者核查最终稿。
